qualification.details: Ph.D. in Computational Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biophysics, Biology, or a related field. Must have experience in Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations and enhanced sampling. Desirable: Experience in protein/peptide simulations, coarse-grained/all-atom MD, and enhanced sampling. A good knowledge of GROMACS or any other biomolecular simulation packages is preferred.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati is 13 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Computational Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biophysics, Biology, or a related field with specific experience in Molecular Dynamics simulations.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 58000 to Rs. 69600 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely Online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position is a Contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q10. When will the shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail on 16 September 2026.
